capabilities: serve rendered markdown, vault files, and Dataview results over a local REST API
execute Dataview DQL queries and DataviewJS code
return output as HTML, plain text, or structured JSON
expose MCP tools (health, render_markdown, render_file, dataview_query, dataviewjs) to AI clients
configure an API key and CORS origins for requests
extras: Desktop-only (no mobile). README includes a detailed section explaining each permission flagged by the community market review (network interfaces, filesystem write for the MCP bridge script, clipboard). Server binds to localhost with optional API key auth; installation is via manually downloaded release files.
problem: Dataview and rendering results live only inside Obsidian, so external scripts or AI agents have no way to fetch them over HTTP.

relations.evidence: may invoke the dataview plugin's JavaScript API when enabled
enables direct integration with AI tools that support the Model Context Protocol
Have Hermes Agent or Claude Code query your vault via API

requires.name: AI client such as Hermes Agent, Claude Code, or Claude Desktop

summary: Local REST API and MCP server that exposes Dataview query results and rendered markdown from a vault to AI tools and external scripts.
